canonical_claim.template: In 2025, The Loan Store, Inc denied {value} of its 3,619 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: The Loan Store, Inc decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: The Loan Store, Inc will deny any specific future application with 10.9% probability
The Loan Store, Inc is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
The Loan Store, Inc discriminates or violates law
10.9% applies to The Loan Store, Inc's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
